acceptanceCriteria: A JS/TS Playwright reader resolves fixture scopes (test default, worker via {scope:'worker'}) and reports advisory CLEANUP-HANDLE-OUTLIVED when a closure registered on a longer-scoped fixture/registry (or afterAll/worker teardown) captures a binding from a shorter-scoped fixture; the finding cites both fixture declarations and the registration line and names the fix (own context in cleanup scope, or cleanup before the short fixture tears down).
Unresolvable scopes, dynamic registries or indirect captures abstain with a named reason; no finding is reported as certain without both scopes resolved from committed source.

A run receipt or manifest that records cleanup as unverified or failed yields a distinct outcome (e.g. PASSED_CLEANUP_FAILED) that selection and witness credit treat as not clean evidence (fail closed), even when every test passed; absence of a cleanup record stays NOT_OBSERVED, not clean.
Spec requirements in docs/specs/test-source-analysis-v0.md (new IDs, traceability rows) with positive, negative and abstain fixture tests for each rule; Closes #1185.
body: GitHub #1185. A cleanup task registered on a worker/suite-scoped registry captures a test-scoped handle (APIRequestContext, page, browser context); at worker shutdown the handle is disposed, every delete fails, tests still pass, and leftovers accumulate. The run manifest records cleanup.verified=false but nothing gates on it. Related: V1-1884/#1168 (teardown order), V1-1900 (data-setup cleanup model).
title: test-validity: CLEANUP-HANDLE-OUTLIVED for cleanup closures capturing a shorter-lived fixture handle, and fail closed on recorded cleanup failure (#1185)
